context: Evaluates whether the agent followed URL conventions from CLAUDE.md and ran the verification script to self-check.

checklist.name: logging_endpoint_exists
checklist.description: A new endpoint is added that returns log messages as JSON.

checklist.name: url_starts_with_awesome
checklist.description: The logging endpoint URL starts with /awesome/ (e.g., /awesome/logs).

checklist.name: ran_verification_script
